name: backup-file-center-direct-preview
title: 统一备份文件中心与直接预览体验
description: Create a daily-discoverable backup file center with node/conditional-backup-set/version/directory navigation and single-click content-faithful safe preview, while preserving the existing Catalog, RBAC, step-up, delivery-ticket, transport, audit, and non-leakage boundaries.
creator: murray
notes: The user approved creation and planning only on 2026-08-27. Decision 1 is B: keep one Backups first-level entry and make Files the default landing surface. Decision 2 is A: node -> conditional Backup Set -> version -> files; hide the selector for one set and never merge versions across tasks. Screenshot feedback makes content fidelity explicit: automatic valid text resolves to faithful plain_text/text_v2, while exact escaped_text/text_v1 remains compatibility-only. Decision 3 is A: a 42/58 resizable desktop browser/preview split with focused-reading mode and sequential narrow-screen fallback. Do not run task.py start or implement until the user explicitly approves the revised completed plan. The node-log P1 and its collectors remain stopped until a usable-content production preview acceptance passes.
